decisions.reason: The fouling detection automation builds on the firm's core automation offer and fits its strategy of digitally networked, energy-efficient infrastructure, and an expanding firm in a growing industry has the slack to carry it while its results are still uncertain.

The weir dimensioning web tool costs little to maintain, supports the firm's flood-control and engineering-planner business, and gives no clear shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.

The fouling detection system complements Product A and the firm's energy recovery direction, so with growth and R&D slack management would keep it, although overlap with Product A brings some risk of consolidation.
